specs.name: power
specs.source_sentence: The first-generation Innova was powered by either a 2.0-litre petrol 100 kW (134 hp; 136 PS) 1TR-FE with VVT-i, a 2.7-litre petrol 118 kW (158 hp; 160 PS) 2TR-FE with VVT-i, or a 2.5-litre 102 PS (75 kW; 101 hp) 2KD-FTV D-4D common rail turbocharged diesel engine.

specs.name: torque
specs.source_sentence: The diesel variants used a turbocharged 2KD-FTV engine which produces 75 kW (101 hp; 102 PS) and 260 N⋅m (26.5 kg⋅m; 192 lb⋅ft) of torque when mated to the four-speed automatic transmission and 200 N⋅m (20.4 kg⋅m; 148 lb⋅ft) when mated to the five-speed manual.

specs.name: engine_cc
specs.source_sentence: In August 2016, the 2.7-litre petrol engine option was introduced, in response to the ban on diesel vehicles with engine capacities over 2,000 cc in Delhi and NCR.

specs.name: engine_litre
specs.source_sentence: Three variants of the Innova came with a petrol engine option which was powered by a 2.0-litre engine with electronic fuel injection.

specs.name: top_speed
specs.source_sentence: The claimed top speed is 120 km/h (75 mph).
